definitions.gloss: manned; staffed; with people aboard or on duty
definitions.explanation: Having people on board or attending, as opposed to {無人|むじん}; used of spacecraft, vehicles, stations and facilities.

examples.japanese: {有人|ゆうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧です。
{有人|ゆうじん}⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧⟦{飛行|ひこう}→飛行：03578_hikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: The manned space flight was a success.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昼間|ひるま}→昼間：01713_hiruma⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{有人|ゆうじん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無人|むじん}→無人：13388_mujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This station is staffed only during the day and unstaffed at night.

notes:
Almost always before another noun or with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, and almost always in contrast with ⟦{無人|むじん}→無人：13388_mujin⟧ "unmanned, unstaffed." Not to be confused with ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧ "friend," which has the same reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有人|ゆうじん}⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧⟦{飛行|ひこう}→飛行：03578_hikou⟧・{有人|ゆうじん}⟦{宇宙船|うちゅうせん}→宇宙船：26020_uchuusen⟧: manned spaceflight, manned spacecraft
- {有人|ゆうじん}⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧: a staffed station
- {有人|ゆうじん}⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧: a staffed checkout (vs self-checkout)
- {有人|ゆうじん}{島|とう}: an inhabited island

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無人|むじん}→無人：13388_mujin⟧: unmanned, unstaffed ({無人駅|むじんえき}, ⟦{無人島|むじんとう}→無人島：16950_mujintou⟧)
